PROGRAM refund review

RECORD RefundFacts
  days: integer
  damaged: boolean
  receipt: boolean
  clearance: boolean
  member: boolean

RECORD RefundDecision
  status: "approved" | "rejected"
  reason: "missing_receipt" | "damaged" | "within_window" | "expired" | "clearance"

REQUEST assess refund
  GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  GIVEN decision is RefundDecision
    status: "rejected"
    reason: "expired"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  OUTPUT decision is RefundDecision

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  AND decision is RefundDecision
  DECIDE
    WHEN facts.damaged
      set decision.status to "approved"
      set decision.reason to "damaged"
    WHEN not facts.receipt
      set decision.status to "rejected"
      set decision.reason to "missing_receipt"
    WHEN facts.days <= 30
      set decision.status to "approved"
      set decision.reason to "within_window"
    ELSE
      set decision.status to "rejected"
      set decision.reason to "expired"

SCENARIO ordinary refund
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 30
  damaged: false
  receipt: true
  clearance: false
  member: false

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "approved"
AND decision.reason == "within_window"

SCENARIO damaged without receipt
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 46
  damaged: true
  receipt: false
  clearance: false
  member: false

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "approved"
AND decision.reason == "damaged"

SCENARIO clearance damage
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 10
  damaged: true
  receipt: true
  clearance: true
  member: false

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "approved"
AND decision.reason == "damaged"

SCENARIO member day forty five
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 45
  damaged: false
  receipt: true
  clearance: false
  member: true

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "rejected"
AND decision.reason == "expired"

SCENARIO undamaged without receipt
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 0
  damaged: false
  receipt: false
  clearance: false
  member: false

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "rejected"
AND decision.reason == "missing_receipt"

SCENARIO ordinary expired refund
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 31
  damaged: false
  receipt: true
  clearance: false
  member: false

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "rejected"
AND decision.reason == "expired"

SCENARIO old damaged clearance without receipt
GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  days: 365
  damaged: true
  receipt: false
  clearance: true
  member: true

REQUEST assess refund

THEN decision.status == "approved"
AND decision.reason == "damaged"

PROGRAM refund review

RECORD RefundFacts
  days: integer
  damaged: boolean
  receipt: boolean
  clearance: boolean
  member: boolean

RECORD RefundDecision
  status: "approved" | "rejected"
  reason: "missing_receipt" | "damaged" | "within_window" | "expired" | "clearance"

REQUEST assess refund
  GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  GIVEN decision is RefundDecision
    status: "rejected"
    reason: "expired"
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  OUTPUT decision is RefundDecision

WHEN assess <facts> into <decision>
  GIVEN facts is RefundFacts
  AND decision is RefundDecision
  DECIDE
    WHEN facts.clearance
      set decision.status to "rejected"
      set decision.reason to "clearance"
    WHEN facts.damaged
      set decision.status to "approved"
      set decision.reason to "damaged"
    WHEN not facts.receipt
      set decision.status to "rejected"
      set decision.reason to "missing_receipt"
    WHEN facts.member and facts.days <= 45
      set decision.status to "approved"
      set decision.reason to "within_window"
    WHEN facts.days <= 30
      set decision.status to "approved"
      set decision.reason to "within_window"
    ELSE
      set decision.status to "rejected"
      set decision.reason to "expired"
